# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Nearly fourteen  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Gil  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, aw'fly handsome boy with curly brown hair and roguish hazel eyes. His mouth is often twisted into a teasing smile.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)_

## Personality

Gilbert is clever, good-natured, and thoughtful, with a keen sense of humor and a tendency to tease others. He is determined to succeed in his studies and work hard to achieve his ambitions. Though competitive in school, he is broad-minded, talks thoughtfully about deeper subjects, and possesses a self-sacrificing and generous disposition.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)_

## History

Gilbert spent three years in Alberta with his father, during which he attended little school. After visiting cousins in New Brunswick, he returned to Avonlea and resumed his studies in the Fourth Book. He engaged in a intense academic rivalry with Anne Shirley, competing for the top position in class and during the Queen's Academy Entrance examinations. Upon attending Queen's Academy, he elected to take the Second Year work to earn a First Class teacher's license in one year. After graduating, he intended to teach to pay his way through college. Knowing Anne wished to stay with Marilla, Gilbert withdrew his application for the Avonlea school so she could take it, choosing instead to teach at White Sands.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)_
